title: 第23章 废陆家兄弟丹田第24章 陆乾父子的算计
content_zh:
房间内，看到强如陆修都被陆宸一拳干废，陆鸣吓破胆，疯狂朝着房外逃，不敢多留一秒。
不过，陆宸前不久刚给过陆鸣一次好好活着的机会，不会再给第二次机会了。
脚底一点星芒闪过，下一刻，陆宸出现在了陆鸣身前，接着一脚踹向了眼神恐惧的陆鸣。
第二次走在被废的边缘，陆鸣怒吼，他放弃了身上的其它部位，只是拼死护住有丹田的小腹。
“噗嗤！”
随着陆宸一脚落下，陆鸣口吐鲜血，随后做了自由落体运动，重重的摔倒在陆修身旁。
此时，他虽然拼死保住了自己的丹田，但却是五脏剧痛，哇的一声，又喷出了一口鲜血。
一脚重伤陆鸣，陆宸一步步逼近两人。
陆修眼神恐惧道：“陆宸，你想做什么？”
陆宸道：“你想废了我，你觉得我想做什么？”
陆修脸色大变，大声喝叱道：“你我同出一门，你不能废我，要不然所有人都会指责你手段残忍。”
“我去你娘的同出一门。”
听到这个陆宸就来气，只见他一步跨出，一脚踢向陆修的小腹，接着陆修的丹田噗嗤一声就爆了。
丹田破碎，一股灵气从陆修体内流出，失去灵力的陆修则像是一个泄气的皮球，瞬间就蔫了。
“你……你居然……真的废了我的丹田，陆宸，你好狠毒。”
陆修脸色苍白的指着陆宸，眼中充满了怨恨。
陆宸冷笑道：“我不过是用你对付我的手段对付你，结果你现在却说我手段狠毒，真是可笑。”
闻言，陆修面如死灰。
他被废了，从今天开始，他变成了和陆毅一样的废人，想到陆毅这些年的遭遇，陆修绝望了。
而在收拾了陆修后，陆宸转头看向了陆鸣。

看到陆宸毫不犹豫的废了他的大哥，陆鸣吓尿了，他想逃，结果却发现自己的两条腿已经被吓软了。
当陆宸看向自己时，陆鸣心境崩塌，连滚带爬的向陆宸磕头求饶：“陆宸，我错了，求你再给我一次机会。”
陆宸冷漠道：“我给过你机会了，奈何你自己不中用啊。”
话音未落，陆宸出手，一脚踢爆了陆鸣的丹田，把这个一直把别人喊作废物的人变成了废人。
丹田被废，陆鸣瘫倒在地。
此时，兄弟俩像丢了魂一样，眼睛直直的看着前方。
可这还不算完，陆宸对两人道：“你们这么喜欢看别人磕头求饶，你们现在也给我磕吧，让我也感受一下那种快感，把我磕高兴了，我就放你们回去。”
一听这话，陆修怒吼道：“陆宸，士可杀，不可辱，我是觉得不会向你磕头求饶的。”
陆宸笑着道：“不磕头，只是因为筹码不够，只要筹码够了，我相信你一定会磕头的。”
陆修惨笑道：“陆宸，我的丹田已经被你废了，你已经没有威胁我的筹码了，要杀要剐，都由你说了算。”
“真的？”
陆宸道。
content_en:
In the room, seeing someone as strong as Lu Xiu being defeated by Lu Chen with one punch, Lu Ming was so frightened that he frantically ran away from the room, not daring to stay a second longer.
However, Lu Chen had just given Lu Ming a chance to live a good life not long ago and would not give him a second chance.
A star flashed under his feet, and the next moment, Lu Chen appeared in front of Lu Ming, and then kicked Lu Ming, who had fearful eyes.
Walking on the edge of being crippled for the second time, Lu Ming roared angrily. He gave up other parts of his body and only tried his best to protect his lower abdomen with Dantian.
"Pfft!"
As Lu Chen landed, Lu Ming vomited blood, then performed a free fall and fell heavily next to Lu Xiu.
At this time, although he tried his best to save his Dantian, his internal organs were in severe pain, and with a cry, he spurted out another mouthful of blood.
Lu Ming was seriously injured with a kick, and Lu Chen approached the two of them step by step.
Lu Xiu said with fear in his eyes: "Lu Chen, what do you want to do?"
Lu Chen said: "You want to destroy me, what do you think I want to do?"
Lu Xiu's expression changed drastically, and he yelled loudly: "You and I come from the same school, you can't destroy me, otherwise everyone will accuse you of being cruel."
"I'll go to the same house as your mother."
Lu Chen got angry when he heard this. He took one step forward and kicked Lu Xiu in the lower abdomen. Lu Xiu's Dantian exploded with a pop.
The Dantian was shattered, and a stream of spiritual energy flowed out of Lu Xiu's body. Lu Xiu, who had lost his spiritual energy, was like a deflated rubber ball, instantly wilting.
"You...you actually...really destroyed my Dantian, Lu Chen, you are so cruel."
Lu Xiu pointed at Lu Chen with a pale face, his eyes filled with resentment.
Lu Chen sneered: "I just used the same methods you used to deal with me to deal with you, but now you are saying that my methods are vicious. It's really ridiculous."
Hearing this, Lu Xiu's face was ashen.
He was crippled. From today on, he became a cripple like Lu Yi. Thinking of Lu Yi's experiences over the years, Lu Xiu despaired.
After taking care of Lu Xiu, Lu Chen turned to look at Lu Ming.
Seeing Lu Chen destroying his eldest brother without hesitation, Lu Ming was so frightened that he wanted to run away, but found that his legs had become weak from fear.
When Lu Chen looked at him, Lu Ming's heart collapsed. He kowtowed to Lu Chen and begged for mercy: "Lu Chen, I was wrong. Please give me another chance."
Lu Chen said coldly: "I gave you a chance, but you didn't use it."
Before he finished speaking, Lu Chen took action and kicked Lu Ming's pubic area, turning this man who had always called others trash into a useless person.
The Dantian was destroyed and Lu Ming collapsed to the ground.
At this time, the two brothers looked straight ahead as if they had lost their souls.
But it wasn't over yet. Lu Chen said to the two of them: "You like to see others kowtow and beg for mercy so much. Kowtow to me now, so that I can feel the pleasure. If you make me happy, I will let you go back."
Upon hearing this, Lu Xiu roared: "Lu Chen, a scholar can be killed but not humiliated. I don't think I will kowtow to you and beg for mercy."
Lu Chen said with a smile: "You don't kowtow just because you don't have enough chips. As long as you have enough chips, I believe you will kowtow."
Lu Xiu smiled miserably and said, "Lu Chen, my Dantian has been destroyed by you. You no longer have any leverage to threaten me. It's up to you to decide whether to kill or behead me."
"Really?"
Lu Chen said.
